text: Ghulam Hassan Sofi (1932, Srinagar – 2009, Srinagar[1]) was a renowned singer and harmonium player specializing in the traditional music of Kashmir, India.[2][3][4][5] He launched his career at Radio Kashmir, a local station of All India Radio, in the early 1950s, and also performed for Doordarshan Kendra Srinagar and the Cultural Academy. He served as part of the staff in the Song and Drama Division from 1967 to 1994. Sofi performed in various states of India beyond Kashmir. In 2006, he was honored with a lifetime award by the Union Information Ministry and the Sheikh Mohammad Abdullah award by the State Government. He sang the lyrics of prominent Kashmiri poets Ghulam Ahmad Mehjoor, Abdul Ahad Azad, Wahab Khar, Rasool Mir, and Rajab Hamid. His own compositions frequently explored spiritual and mystical themes.[citation needed]
